definitions.explanation: A journey to visit a series of temples, shrines, or other sacred places, often following an established route.

definitions.gloss: pilgrimage (anime/media), visiting real-life locations from fictional works
definitions.explanation: In modern usage, visiting real-world locations that appeared in anime, manga, films, or other media. Also called {聖地|せいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧{巡礼|じゅんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: To set out on the Shikoku pilgrimage.

examples.japanese: {八十八|はちじゅうはち}か{所|しょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巡礼|じゅんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}した→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I completed the pilgrimage to all eighty-eight temples.

examples.japanese: {巡礼|じゅんれい}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{白装束|しろしょうぞく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: Pilgrims were walking in white robes.

examples.japanese: ⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{聖地|せいち}→聖地：18255_seichi⟧{巡礼|じゅんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To make a pilgrimage to anime locations.

examples.english: Cases where anime pilgrimages contribute to local tourism are increasing.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The most famous Japanese pilgrimage is the {四国八十八|しこくはちじゅうはち}か{所|しょ}⟦{巡|めぐ}り→巡る：03930_meguru⟧ (Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage), a roughly 1,200 km route visiting 88 Buddhist temples associated with {弘法大師|こうぼうだいし} (Kōbō Daishi).

MODERN USAGE:
⟦{聖地|せいち}→聖地：18255_seichi⟧{巡礼|じゅんれい} ("sacred site pilgrimage") has become a major cultural phenomenon where fans visit real locations that appeared in anime, manga, or films. This has become a significant driver of regional tourism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巡礼|じゅんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to set out on a pilgrimage)
- {巡礼|じゅんれい}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (pilgrim)
- ⟦{聖地|せいち}→聖地：18255_seichi⟧{巡礼|じゅんれい} (sacred site pilgrimage / anime location pilgrimage)
